name: Jiri
description: Arrus's littermate and a Ghor warrior who looks after him, is burned by the bad ink, and finally stands with Arrus.

timeline.summary: Arrus tattoos Jiri and learns Dryzek may challenge Ruric and Thar for chieftain.
timeline.quote: I think he's going to challenge Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain,

timeline.summary: The ink Arrus made bursts into flame on Jiri, Dryzek and other warriors, and Ruric and Thar cast Arrus out of the clan.
timeline.quote: Your services are no longer needed here,

timeline.summary: Clanless, Arrus notices the Rubblebelt's plants, animals and food are all failing and tries to warn Jiri, who refuses to listen.
timeline.quote: Something's been sucking the life out of the Rubblebelt these last couple months.

timeline.summary: Arrus challenges Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain and is beaten, repeatedly defying them.
timeline.quote: Ruric pounds his huge fist on the top of my head, and I crumple to the ground

timeline.summary: Arrus tells the clan that Selesnya is draining the Rubblebelt, and Jiri, Baas, Dryzek and others join him in flames.
timeline.quote: He stands behind me, and my flames all but leap for him.

relations.quote: Good battle today," grunts Jiri, my littermate

pages_say.description: Arrus's littermate and a Ghor warrior who looks after him, is burned by the bad ink, and finally stands with Arrus.
